scenario: Fire-then-sample ordering per LSER.10.14. The where-clause sees the pre-sample series snapshot; sample absorption fires after the firing decision lands. Pin: a series and a rule reading `count(t.state) >= 3` compile. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: the ordering is a runtime property. `compile_ok` has no `lowered_contains`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where count(t.state) >= 3
->
    log info "x"
